text: With scope locked, this is the first real architecture decision: how Partner Warranty Claims actually gets built.
It's built as its own scoped application, x_brind_claims -- isolated from everything else Brindlewood already runs.
And partners get a real Scripted REST API, not just a portal -- because their own software can't click through a web form.
Owen Castellano confirms the scoped app keeps this safely separate from Brindlewood's other customizations.
Next: designing the Warranty Claim table and the fields its ACL will depend on.
